United States.workAfter: Up to 1 year OPT (3 for STEM)
United States.note: Apply through Common App; many colleges need financial proof and the CSS Profile.

United Kingdom.note: Undergraduate applications go through UCAS; Oxford and Cambridge close on Oct 15.

Canada.workAfter: Post-graduation work permit up to 3 years
Canada.note: Study permit and proof of funds required; provincial attestation letters now apply.

Germany.workDuring: 120 full days or 240 half days per year
Germany.note: Uzbek school certificates often need Studienkolleg or one year of university before a bachelor; check uni-assist.

Netherlands.workDuring: Up to 16h/week or full-time in summer
Netherlands.note: Apply through Studielink; many programmes have an early Jan 15 deadline.

Finland.note: Joint application via Studyinfo in January.

Denmark.note: Apply through optagelse.dk; Mar 15 for non-EU.

Switzerland.note: Bachelor is usually taught in German or French; entrance exam may apply.

Hungary.note: Stipendium Hungaricum covers tuition, housing and a stipend; deadline mid-January.

Poland.note: Low cost and many English programmes; apply through each university.

Italy.note: Pre-enrolment on Universitaly; DSU regional scholarships reduce costs.

France.note: Apply via Études en France; French level often required.

South Korea.note: GKS scholarship covers everything; many universities apply in September.

Japan.note: English-taught programmes include PEAK (Tokyo), iUP (Kyoto) and SPSF (Sophia).

China.note: Chinese Government Scholarship covers tuition, housing and a stipend.

Singapore.note: Tuition Grant lowers fees in exchange for working in Singapore for three years.

Turkey.note: Türkiye Scholarships cover tuition, housing and a stipend.

Azerbaijan.note: Apply directly or through the government scholarship.

Kazakhstan.note: Nazarbayev University teaches in English; most others in Russian or Kazakh.

Uzbekistan.note: Several international branch campuses offer English-taught degrees.

Australia.note: Application deadlines vary by university; Oct 31 is a common early deadline.

United Arab Emirates.note: NYU Abu Dhabi is need-blind with large aid packages.
